summary: UTime Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the pricing and closing of a $50 million private placement under Regulation S. The company sold 50,000,000 units at $1.00 per unit, each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share and one warrant to purchase four Class A ordinary shares at $1.10 per share. Warrants are exercisable immediately and expire May 18, 2031. Officers and directors entered 180-day lock-up agreements. Proceeds will be used for general working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
